title: fixture_rewriter + passthrough default
description: fixture_rewriter(path) reads a precomputed rewrites JSONL into a {query: rewrites} dict and returns a rewrite(query)->list[str] callable, so CLI/eval run the full fan-out without a live agent or API key. Also provide a trivial passthrough default (lambda q: []) that collapses to plain rerank-hybrid.
close_reason: Implemented fixture_rewriter and passthrough_rewriter in rag_core/multi_query_retriever.py

title: Adapter: make_multi_query_retriever (drop-in retriever)
description: Wrap a rewriter Callable[[str],list[str]] into the standard (query,db_url,top_k) interface, mirroring make_reranking_retriever. include_original prepends the original query; default base_retriever = make_reranking_retriever(hybrid_retrieve) (rerank-hybrid); map standard top_k -> final_k and per_query_k -> per-query k_i; set __name__ for eval labeling.

title: Core: multi_query_retrieve (fan-out + normalize + merge/dedup)
description: New module rag_core/multi_query_retriever.py. Implement multi_query_retrieve(queries, db_url, base_retriever, top_k=5, final_k=None): dedup/clean queries, run base_retriever per query, min-max normalize each per-query rerank-score list (guard len==1 / all-equal -> 1.0), union by chunk_id keeping max normalized score with a 'queries' provenance list, sort desc, truncate to final_k. Returns {'results':[{chunk_id,source,text,score,queries}]}.

title: Multi-query fan-out retriever (query rewriter — RAG side)
description: Add steps 2-5 of the query rewriter to this repo: for a pre-computed list of rewritten queries, retrieve+rerank each independently, normalize per-query rerank scores, then union/dedup by chunk_id into a merged result set. Consumes a list[str] produced by a separate agent repo (step 1); no LLM call happens here. See plan: /Users/akshatsaxena/.claude/plans/im-trying-to-add-imperative-yao.md
design: Reuse make_reranking_retriever(hybrid_retrieve) as the per-query pipeline and the provenance pattern from hybrid_retriever.py. Contract: multi_query_retrieve(queries, db_url, base_retriever, top_k, final_k). Merge = min-max normalize each per-query list then dedup keeping max score. Adapter make_multi_query_retriever(rewriter,...) makes it a drop-in for the RETRIEVERS dict and run_eval.
acceptance_criteria: multiquery retriever is selectable in rag_retrieval.py and eval_retrieval.py; A/B eval vs rerank-hybrid runs and produces a saved report
close_reason: All child tasks complete: multi_query_retrieve core + adapter + fixture_rewriter implemented in rag_core/multi_query_retriever.py, exported and wired into RETRIEVERS dict in rag_retrieval.py/eval_retrieval.py, unit tests passing, eval rewrites fixture generated, and A/B eval (multiquery vs rerank-hybrid) verified via CLI smoke test and eval reports.

title: [separate repo] Agent-side query rewriter (step 1)
description: Tracking issue for the agent repo (NOT this repo).
